Resume Builder is a special segment of C-Suite Unscripted where Senior Editor Maggie McGrath breaks down the resumes of influential executives. description:
On this episode of Iconoclast, Inspired Capital Founder and Managing Partner Alexa von Tobel sat down with Forbes to discuss launching her venture capital firm alongside former U.S. Secretary of Commerce Penny Pritzker. Von Tobel also discussed dropping out of Harvard Business School to build LearnVest during the 2008 financial crisis, Inspired Capital’s newly closed $450 million fourth fund, and the traits of relentless early-stage founders.
